lines.text: Did I pick the right outfit?
Your hair is on point today.

data.define: Used for something that is perfectly done or stylish.

example.text: Your hair is on point today.

misuse.text: Don't say 'on point' about a sharp pencil.
misuse.why: It means perfect and exactly right.

hook.text: Did I pick the right outfit?

publish.title: What does "on point" mean?
publish.value: On point = Perfect and exactly right. Example: "Your hair is on point today." (casual English, US).
